boxes.title: Kingship: added detail
items: Forms of rule (Aitareya Br.): ==**Rajya, Bhojya, Swarajya, Vairajya, Samrajya**==
Regions named after the ==tribes that first settled== there
Functions: protect territory, run administration, **patronise ritual**
Aitareya: kingship from need for a ==**war leader**==, later divine sanction

items: Kuru-Panchala: ruled upper Ganga valley via **marriage** + military links
